subject: Re: Final approval timeline & SOW for production onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stellaretail.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final approval timeline & SOW for production onboarding

Hi Tessa / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the throughput numbers and the routing/fallback plan. We're ready to move forward, pending a quick legal review and final sign-off. Attached are the latest SOW (v3) and a MAP workbook that shows milestones we discussed.

High-level ask: can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday (28 May)?
- Final sign-off owner for Redwood at the VP level (we need the name for our procurement intake)
- E-signature window: are you able to commit to DocuSign envelope next week? Ideally we sign before 03 Jun to hit our internal onboarding window.
- Start date for production traffic: our target is 14 Jun. We need a committed start slot so we can schedule our release.

I've copied Jacob from procurement in case any PO or billing alignment is needed.

Attachments: SOW_v3.pdf, MAP_Stellar_202705.xlsx

Thanks —
Marta Lopez
VP Product, Stellar Retail
[m] +1 (415) 555-0143

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stellaretail.com>, Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@stellaretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final approval timeline & SOW for production onboarding

Marta —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Short answers and owners below; more detail in the MAP workbook (attached).

- Redwood exec approver: Ben Carter (VP, Sales) will be primary signatory for commercial terms; Laura Bennett (Head of Legal) will countersign for contract language.
- DocuSign: yes — we can route a DocuSign envelope. Proposed envelope send: Tue 31 May (internal routing) with signer window through Fri 03 Jun. Please confirm that window works for your team.
- Start date: we can commit to an initial production ramp starting 14 Jun, with a short canary period (14–18 Jun) and full cutover by 21 Jun. If you need the earlier or later slot, flag now.

Notes / requests for procurement:
- Please confirm PO cadence (one-time vs recurring monthly billing) and whether Stellar needs an invoice prior to e-signature. If procurement needs anything specific we can surface it from finance.

I've attached the edited MAP with the exact dates and responsible owners. I will kick the DocuSign flow once we have confirmation on the signer window.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_Stellar_202705.xlsx]

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final approval timeline & SOW for production onboarding

Quick internal sync —

Laura / Tessa, I reviewed SOW_v3 and the commercial worksheet. I can be the exec approver for the commercial side and will sign on DocuSign. Laura, can legal do a 24–48 hour turnaround on the small redline we discussed (data retention clause and SLA percent)? If so we can keep the envelope send on Tue 31 May.

If legal needs more time, suggest we still send the envelope with a conditional comment and route to Ben (exec) first then to Laura. We prefer to avoid delaying Stellar's 14 Jun target.

— Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stellaretail.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final approval timeline & SOW for production onboarding

On Wed, May 26, 2027 at 08:17 AM ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Laura / Tessa, I reviewed SOW_v3 and the commercial worksheet. I can be the exec approver for the commercial side and will sign on DocuSign. Laura, can legal do a 24–48 hour turnaround on the small redline we discussed (data retention clause and SLA percent)? If so we can keep the envelope send on Tue 31 May.

Thanks — we completed the review and I uploaded a single redline to SOW_v3. The change is limited to the SLA appendix (percent thresholds) and one sentence clarifying log retention for customer-managed keys. Laura Bennett (Legal) has okayed the changes and will countersign after Ben signs.

Tessa: please proceed with the DocuSign envelope send now (I have confirmed countersign flow). Marta / Jacob: we will send the DocuSign link to Stellar legal and procurement as soon as the envelope is live.

Final operational plan (summary):
- Tue 31 May: DocuSign envelope created and sent to Ben (exec) first, then Laura (legal).
- Wed 01 Jun–Fri 03 Jun: Expected signature window.
- Mon 14 Jun: Canary production traffic begins (24–72h monitoring window).
- Mon 21 Jun: Full production cutover if metrics meet thresholds.

Attachments: security-checklist.pdf

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_v3_redlined.pdf]
